name: clawpod-node-host
title: ClawPod Node Host
description: Use when a user wants to connect a Linux, macOS, or Windows computer to ClawPod. Guide agent and computer Tailscale sign-in, select the standalone ClawPod Node installer, provide Gateway connection values, verify device pairing, guide desktop permissions, and explain app recovery or removal. Use node-connect when available for an already configured node that fails to connect or pair.
whenToUse: Sign the agent in to Tailscale and help connect my computer to the same tailnet
Install ClawPod Node on Linux and connect this computer to ClawPod
Download the ClawPod Node installer for my Apple Silicon or Intel Mac
Set up ClawPod Node on a Windows 11 PC with the standalone installer
Guide Gateway setup and approve the actual pending device pairing request
Explain ClawPod Node app recovery or removal

agent.status.description: Check the agent runtime's own Tailscale connection for onboarding step 1. If signed out, use agent.login. When connected, continue to the user computer's Tailscale setup (step 2). This does not prove the computer or Gateway endpoint is reachable.

agent.login.description: Start the agent's Tailscale sign-in only when signed out, return the user sign-in link, then recheck agent.status. An already connected agent is left unchanged. Continue with computer Tailscale setup, OS/CPU selection, and the standalone installer.

installer.info.description: Select a standalone ClawPod Node installer from the bundled release manifest and return app connection, OS-specific Desktop setup, and node-tool guidance. Requires the target computer platform and architecture. The agent separately obtains and gives the user the verified Gateway Tailscale address, full endpoint, and actual token/password. This command does not read deployment credentials, check remote availability, install software, or change services. Optional gatewayUrl: Gateway root URL. Private and Tailscale IP ws:// connections need no enable option. Use wss:// when the endpoint provides TLS.
